resource_note: Current MATLAB realization uses FFT-domain ideal filtering; a polyphase FIR FPGA/DSP implementation has different RAM/compute.
Current implementation is batch/block DWT with MATLAB Huffman dictionaries; lifting/streaming DWT can materially reduce target RAM.
This is the current dense-matrix MATLAB implementation. Structured/implicit sensing + FFT can reduce RAM by orders of magnitude; current encoder also runs OMP only for diagnostics.
Encoder cost is dominated by candidate-model fitting and rate-distortion search; decoder evaluates only the selected model/residual and is much lighter.
The 2 MiB term comes from this MATLAB fixed-table LZW implementation, not from the SVDCS paper FPGA. Paper reports logic utilization but does not give exact RAM used.
